title: Provider-client integration and bulk reads

rework.reason: implementation-reviewer attempt 1 returned CHANGES_REQUIRED with MEDIUM 11.2-F1 (stale current v1.1 suite counts in docs/limitations.md V6 and docs/project-status.md) plus LOW 11.2-F3 (unbounded bulk id list) and 11.2-F4 (architecture overclaim about per-item file reads); test-quality-reviewer attempt 1 returned PASS_WITH_FINDINGS with MEDIUM TQ-11.2-1 (the provider-failure test was inert because the fresh cache short-circuited before any provider call), TQ-11.2-2 (the Sonarr over-bound fallback test was insensitive), TQ-11.2-3 (one-read-per-window reused a single identity and passed with a single-record cache), and TQ-11.2-4 (no single-flight coalescing of concurrent cold-cache populations, so the one-read-per-window criterion was unverified under a cold-start race), plus LOW TQ-11.2-5/-6. All attempt-1 findings were independently confirmed closed in attempt 2.
